mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM BOARD GROUP BY BOARD_TYPE ORDER BY BOARD_TYPE
SELECT EVENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM AUDIT_LOG WHERE REGIST_DT >= #{startDate} AND REGIST_DT < #{endDate} GROUP BY EVENT_TYPE ORDER BY CNT DESC, EVENT_TYPE

SELECT CAST(REGIST_DT AS DATE) AS STAT_DATE, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM AUDIT_LOG WHERE EVENT_TYPE IN ('LOGIN_SUCCESS', 'API_LOGIN') AND REGIST_DT >= #{startDate} AND REGIST_DT < #{endDate} GROUP BY CAST(REGIST_DT AS DATE) ORDER BY STAT_DATE

SELECT CAST(REGIST_DT AS DATE) AS STAT_DATE, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM AUDIT_LOG WHERE EVENT_TYPE IN ('MENU_ACCESS', 'PII_VIEW', 'PII_DOWNLOAD', 'API_ACCESS') AND REGIST_DT >= #{startDate} AND REGIST_DT < #{endDate} GROUP BY CAST(REGIST_DT AS DATE) ORDER BY STAT_DATE
SELECT TARGET_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM AUDIT_LOG WHERE EVENT_TYPE = 'PII_DOWNLOAD' AND REGIST_DT >= #{startDate} AND REGIST_DT < #{endDate} GROUP BY TARGET_TYPE ORDER BY CNT DESC
